description: Medications from NLM's RxNorm Current Prescribable Content, keyed by RxCUI. Each concept carries its own name plus its relations to other concepts (ingredients, dose form, brand names, generic), so a consumer can display a coded medication (e.g. from a CCD or a FHIR MedicationRequest) with a single lookup.

tty.description: RxNorm term type, e.g. IN (ingredient), BN (brand name), SCD (generic drug), SBD (branded drug), GPCK/BPCK (packs).

synonyms.description: Alternate RxNorm names for the concept, including Tall Man spellings (e.g. buPROPion). May be empty.

strengths.description: One entry for an actual drug (SCD, SBD); every strength sold for a drug group (SCDG, SBDG), lowest first; empty when the concept has no strength.

relations.description: The other concepts this one points at, ordered by type (in the order of the enum) and then by RxCUI. Never includes the concept itself. May be empty.

type.description: ingredient: a base ingredient (IN) the concept contains. dose_form: its dose form (DF), at most one. own_brand: the brand name (BN) a branded concept is sold as. sold_as: a brand name (BN) a generic concept is marketed under; for an ingredient this includes combination products. generic: the generic concept a branded concept is the brand of (exactly one for SBD and BPCK).
